profiles.shortDescription: Moventas is a Flender-owned brand for wind-turbine gearboxes and associated gearbox services. Flender's official acquisition record identifies Moventas as a Finnish wind gearbox manufacturer with engineering and multibrand service capabilities.
fullDescription: Flender's manufacturer-owned press archive records the completed 2022 acquisition of Moventas and identifies its specialization in wind-turbine gearboxes.
The documented business scope combines gearbox engineering with service capabilities that support wind-drive installations and multibrand fleets.

profiles.shortDescription: Moxa develops industrial networking, connectivity and edge-computing products. Its official portfolio includes Ethernet switches, serial device servers, industrial wireless equipment, edge computers and network-management software.
fullDescription: Moxa's official product directory documents hardware and software for connecting, computing and managing industrial networks.
The published range spans industrial Ethernet, serial connectivity, wireless networking, edge computers, protocol gateways and network-management tools for operational technology environments.

profiles.shortDescription: MSE Filterpressen manufactures filter-press systems for solid-liquid separation. Its range includes chamber, membrane and heated filter presses together with modular equipment and application-specific accessories.
fullDescription: MSE Filterpressen's official product directory presents pressure-filtration machinery for separating solids from liquids in industrial processes.
The documented range includes chamber and membrane filter presses, heated designs, modular CellTRON systems and peripherals for configured filtration installations.

profiles.shortDescription: MSW Motion Control manufactures electromechanical motion components. Its official range covers electric cylinders, geared motors and clutch-brake systems for industrial positioning and drive applications.
fullDescription: MSW Motion Control's official site identifies a German manufacturer of components for controlled linear and rotary motion.
The published product scope includes electric cylinders, DC geared motors and combined clutch-brake systems used in machinery and automation.

profiles.shortDescription: MTA develops industrial process-cooling and compressed-air treatment equipment. Its official portfolio includes chillers, dry coolers, air dryers, filters and related thermal-management systems.
fullDescription: MTA's official product directory documents equipment for controlling process temperature and treating compressed air in industrial plants.
The portfolio covers water chillers, free-cooling and dry-cooler systems, refrigerated and adsorption dryers, filtration products and configured cooling solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: MTH Pumps manufactures regenerative-turbine, centrifugal and sealless pumps. The official range supports industrial fluid circulation, process service and compact pumping applications.
fullDescription: MTH Pumps' manufacturer-owned site documents a pump company operating from Plano, Illinois, since 1965.
Its standard product scope includes regenerative-turbine, centrifugal and sealless designs for industrial circulation, process and equipment applications.

profiles.shortDescription: mtu is a Rolls-Royce Power Systems brand for engines, propulsion and distributed energy systems. Its official application portfolio covers diesel engines, generator sets and integrated power solutions for industrial, marine and infrastructure use.
fullDescription: The official mtu application directory presents power and propulsion systems operated within Rolls-Royce Power Systems.
The documented scope includes high-speed engines, generator sets, marine propulsion and configured energy systems for mission-critical and industrial applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Mueller Industries manufactures copper tube, fittings, valves and engineered flow-control components. Its official portfolio serves plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration and industrial applications.
fullDescription: Mueller Industries' official product directory groups a broad range of metal products and components for fluid distribution and thermal systems.
The documented portfolio includes copper tube and fittings, valves, refrigeration components and engineered products used across building systems and industrial equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Mulco coordinates a European product range for polyurethane timing belts and matching drive components. Its official scope includes timing belts, pulleys, tensioning elements and linear-drive solutions.
fullDescription: Mulco's official site presents a European network focused on polyurethane timing-belt technology for power transmission and positioning.
The published portfolio includes timing belts, pulleys, tensioning components and application-specific linear-drive products for machinery and automation.

profiles.shortDescription: Multi-Wing develops axial fan impellers and configured fan systems for thermal management. Its official range combines blades, hubs and complete fan assemblies for mobile and stationary equipment.
fullDescription: Multi-Wing's official product directory documents modular axial-fan technology for moving air through cooling and ventilation systems.
The portfolio includes configurable impellers, blades, hubs and complete fan solutions used in engines, HVAC equipment and industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: MYCOM is Mayekawa's compressor brand for industrial refrigeration and gas processing. Its official range includes reciprocating, screw and application-specific compressors used in cooling, freezing and heat-pump systems.
fullDescription: Mayekawa's manufacturer-owned MYCOM pages document compressor technology for industrial refrigeration, freezing and thermal-process applications.
The published scope covers reciprocating, screw and specialized compressor designs integrated into refrigeration, gas and heat-pump systems.

profiles.shortDescription: NACHI-FUJIKOSHI manufactures cutting tools, bearings, hydraulic equipment, machine tools and industrial robots. Its official portfolio combines machining, motion and factory-automation technologies.
fullDescription: NACHI-FUJIKOSHI's official product directory documents a multi-technology industrial portfolio centered on machining and motion control.
The range includes cutting tools, machine tools, bearings, hydraulic components, robots and related systems for manufacturing applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Nadella develops linear-motion and precision mechanical components. Its official portfolio includes linear guides, telescopic rails, rollers, bearings and configured linear modules.
fullDescription: Nadella's official product directory documents components and systems for guided linear movement in industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: NAF is an ANDRITZ brand for industrial control valves and actuators. Its official portfolio includes ball, check, ball-sector, butterfly and capping valves together with actuators and valve positioners.

profiles.shortDescription: Nanotec develops motors and drive electronics for precision motion control. Its official portfolio includes stepper motors, brushless DC motors, motor controllers, drives and linear actuators.
